passes.name: asymmetric_neighbourhoods
passes.prompt: Use case: production game environment background. Create an original warm hand-painted ancient Chinese capital interior, landscape 1536x1024. IMAGE 1 is the user's preferred ARCHITECTURAL COMPOSITION reference: convincing designed urban fabric, staggered clusters of houses, narrow lanes, courtyards, a dominant administrative complex off to one side, not icons spread evenly on grass. IMAGE 2 is the authoritative COLOR and rendering reference from our game: sunlit warm ochre dirt and golden sandstone, natural timber, muted blue-grey roofs, yellow-green foliage, clean soft painted 2.5D detail. IMAGE 3 is the existing background being REDESIGNED; retain its near-top-down north-up camera and warm color family, but replace its rigid symmetrical layout and huge empty lawns entirely. ALL WALL FOOTPRINTS must remain horizontal/vertical relative to the image edges with right-angle turns: no diagonals, diamonds, octagons or chamfered corners. Roofs and wall facades show subtle depth, north-up orthographic elevated plan view, no horizon. Large city has an outer stone city wall roughly x5%-95%,y7%-90%, straight horizontal/vertical lengths, corner watchtowers, south gate offset at x60%, west gate around y52%. Inner city is a SEPARATE COMPLETE rectangular fortified precinct in the NORTHEAST around x58%-90%,y13%-43%, with clear gate in its south wall at x72%, a restrained large warm terracotta-roof government hall near its north side, side halls and tree-shaded paved courtyard. NOT centered palace, NOT bilateral symmetry. Outside inner city: believable human-scaled medieval town, visually designed varied blocks with streets of unequal widths and staggered junctions. West/northwest is clustered residential neighbourhoods with tiny grey-roof row houses, L-shaped compound groupings and communal wells. Center-west has a modest market street, small tan awnings and a wider irregular junction. South-center has artisans and warehouses close to the southern gate. Southwest has garden plots, a small pond and scattered farmhouses. Southeast has a modest military/work yard with a few low sheds. Streets connect all neighborhoods and gates, clear main route with right-angle jogs rather than a perfectly centered cruciform avenue. Background architectural dressing should be SMALL about50-70px wide per roof on a1536px canvas. Place small houses in short uneven groups at street bends and along walls, rather than standalone identical icons. Include many modest unpaved natural warm ochre work courts between groups of small roofs, between x14%-86%,y21%-80%, open areas ranging100-160px across to receive31interactive building sprites later. These spaces are naturally interwoven in the urban fabric, irregular edges, ground shared with lanes, no individual plot outlines, no standardized square pads or rings, no giant empty lawns. Do not arrange the open courts or houses into evenly spaced rows. Mostly worn beige earth with stone paths, scattered olive/yellow-green vegetation, a few slender trees, carts, wells, small vegetable gardens. Balance occupied roof clusters and quiet buildable spaces about45/55, so it already reads as an inhabited city without becoming overcrowded. Keep whole city wall visible within image, a thin moat and subdued meadow outside. No labels, no text, no UI, no ornamental fantasy effects, no pink blossom, no glow. Do NOT copy the reference screenshot's cooler gritty pixel textures, portrait icons, statues or exact buildings. The compositional sophistication of image1 in the warm restrained style of image2.
